supported_dispositions.rationale: The advisory requires a privileged pathname-based acl_get_file/acl_set_file/acl_extended_file/acl_delete_def_file call with an attacker-replaceable pathname component. Exact ELF consumers are root-owned mode 0755 cp, mv, install, sed, tar, useradd and usermod without file capabilities; normal execution does not elevate their caller. Supported runtime paths supply no such privileged ACL operation: app startup uses adjacent regular-file rename, worker jobs dispatch none, account-copy helpers use descriptor ACL operations, and ACL-preserving maintenance or custom native execution is outside this scope. Default app identity alone is not the rationale, and worker root identity is explicitly accounted for.

supported_dispositions.rationale: The vulnerable static xmlSnprintfElements operation is reached by xmlValidateElementContent error reporting. The complete exact-ELF consumer inventory has no imported explicit DTD-validation APIs in its five OS consumers. Retained exact libavformat/libbluray parser sites pass options 0, LLVM passes 0x1100, and librsvg uses NONET/BIG_LINES with optional HUGE, without DTDVALID; xmlCtxtUseOptions clears validation without that flag. update-mime-database handles trusted build-time package data with no supported runtime caller. Current first-party paths provide no DTD-validation or custom OS libxml2 binding entry point.

supported_dispositions.rationale: The advisory concerns IMA-ADPCM WAV file open/close arithmetic. The complete exact-image ELF inventory identifies only libpulsecommon as an OS libsndfile consumer; its retained helpers accept an already-open SNDFILE handle or enumerate formats. File-opening decoder calls belong to absent Pulse daemon/libpulsecore/pacat/pactl code. Installed Pulse clients stream PCM bytes and supply no file-decoding path. Current first-party audio decoding binds the separately bundled SoundFile library; no direct OS sndfile native/CFFI/ctypes path is configured. The OS package remains affected; this record covers its reviewed current use only.

supported_dispositions.rationale: The advisory concerns large SamplesPerPixel amplifying strip/tile allocations. The complete exact-image inventory identifies only the GdkPixbuf TIFF plugin as an OS libtiff consumer. Its installed nonplugin GdkPixbuf consumer, librsvg, uses pixel-access/new APIs and Rust image decoding, with no loader/file/stream decode calls. Current first-party source and the exact image contain no GI/PyGObject or direct OS libtiff decoder route; ordinary Pillow paths bind their separate bundled TIFF library. Installed plugin presence alone does not establish an active OS TIFF input path, and the OS package is not claimed fixed.
